Short family coordination note written for Dad Robert Chen:

**Hi Dad,**

Quick family update:

**Grandpa Joe** – I've scheduled the call to check in and will handle it directly. Nothing urgent required from your side, but I'll give you a heads up if there's anything to follow up on.

**Mom's anniversary gift** – The reminder is sorted and I'm taking care of the order. I'll keep you posted on delivery timing and can coordinate presentation if needed.

Let me know if you want to chat through either—otherwise I'll handle and update you as things progress.

– Alice

(Note: Specific phone numbers, birthdays, private message history, and notification internals excluded per data minimization policy.)
